title: Reproduction code and screened corpus for a survey of evaluation design in reinforcement learning route guidance

creators.name: Lee, Donghoun
creators.affiliation: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Sejong University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description: Reproduction material for the survey "Study-Area Boundaries in Reinforcement Learning-Based Route Guidance: A Survey of Evaluation Design and Reporting Requirements" by Donghoun Lee. The archive contains the grid, benchmark and SUMO environments, the planner, the training code, the screened corpus with the recorded fields of each reviewed study, the screening trail and the overlap analysis. Every value reported in the paper is recomputed from this tree at a linear-algebra thread count pinned to one.
